scope: Evidence-aware extensions; proposal records explicitly retain their open obligations.

equations.title: principal Rees bracket
equations.assumptions: Use the actual 170 rational couplings and the eight principal spins; t is a deformation parameter, not a current mode.

equations.title: nonnegative Rees exponents
equations.equation: a+b-c-1>=0 and a+b-c-1 is even on every allowed channel
equations.assumptions: All eight spins are odd and the actual bracket has positive odd transvectant order.

equations.title: punctured-family scaling
equations.assumptions: Every nonzero fiber is isomorphic to E8; this integer-power gauge creates no automatic new monodromy.

equations.title: polynomial Jacobi specialization
equations.equation: Jacobi_t=0 for t!=0 => Jacobi_t=0 in Q[t] => Jacobi_0=0
equations.assumptions: Polynomial structure constants over an infinite characteristic-zero field and a verified reference bracket.

equations.title: boundary channel support
equations.assumptions: Count reduced principal channels, not basis tensor entries; the other 154 channels vanish at this boundary.

equations.title: nilradical lower-central dimensions
equations.assumptions: The concrete leading-channel algebra is sl2 semidirect n; nilpotency class four follows from nonzero channel images and vanishing next term.

equations.title: boundary center
equations.assumptions: Center of the nilradical, not of the full semidirect product; sl2 acts nontrivially on V_29.

equations.title: Killing-form valuations
equations.assumptions: Pull back the E8 invariant form through S_t. Its specialization has rank three.

equations.title: all invariant forms at the boundary
equations.equation: n subset rad B for every invariant symmetric B on g_0; rank B<=3
equations.assumptions: Multiplicity-free sl2 types are orthogonal, and [V_m,V_m]_0 has no V_1 output for m>1.

equations.title: quadratic completion lower bound
equations.assumptions: Assume g_0 embeds as a Lie subalgebra in finite-dimensional D with a nondegenerate invariant symmetric form; isotropic embeddings require dimension at least 496.

equations.title: cotangent Lie extension
equations.assumptions: The coadjoint action is (ad_x^* beta)(z)=-beta([x,z]); this classical construction gives dimension 496.

equations.title: canonical nondegenerate pairing
equations.assumptions: On g semidirect g*, the canonical symmetric form is invariant and nondegenerate for every family parameter.

equations.title: quadratic Casimir braid identities
equations.assumptions: A nondegenerate invariant symmetric form supplies the Casimir; these identities imply the usual configuration-space connection is flat.

equations.title: diagonal valuation cone
equations.assumptions: A declared integral valuation satisfying all inequalities defines a polynomial contraction; the full cone classification is a separate research gate.

equations.title: affine current bracket
equations.assumptions: The normalized invariant form is transported through the actual Jordan chart; K is central and mode indices are integers.

equations.title: affine cocycle
equations.assumptions: Skew symmetry uses the mode-sum condition; the cocycle identity uses invariance of the bilinear form.

equations.title: mode derivation
equations.assumptions: The derivation extends the current algebra; it is not a derivation of an arbitrary nonideal jet truncation.

equations.title: level-one Sugawara central charge
equations.assumptions: Use the simple affine E8 vertex algebra at level one; this does not permit independent adjoint primary insertions at level one.

equations.title: simple E8 state character
equations.assumptions: Unshifted conformal grading: coefficients begin 1,248,4124,34752,213126. The normalized character includes q^(-1/3).

equations.title: colored-partition recurrence
equations.assumptions: p_r(0)=1 and r is a nonnegative integer; all coefficients use exact integer arithmetic.

equations.title: universal current population
equations.assumptions: PBW dimensions of the universal affine vacuum module; simple-quotient null relations have not yet been imposed.

equations.title: basis-independent state retention
equations.assumptions: This fixed-graded-algebra density differs from coordinate-dependent bracket sparsity and from geometric packing density.

equations.title: A4 root-lattice theta enumeration
equations.equation: Theta_A4(q)=sum_(x in Z^5,sum x_i=0) q^(sum x_i^2/2)
equations.assumptions: The enumeration uses a proved norm bound for each requested finite coefficient; the full identity is a formal theta series.

equations.title: simple Jordan twining series
equations.assumptions: All 124 nonidentity dual-grading automorphisms are conjugate to the fixed-dimension-48 order-five class; the A4+A4 gluing identifies its trace.

equations.title: all-order twining eta identity
equations.assumptions: Both sides are holomorphic weight-four forms on Gamma0(5); the Sturm bound is two. Cusp holomorphy and matching coefficients through q squared give an all-order proof.

equations.title: universal Jordan twining series
equations.assumptions: A nonidentity grading automorphism has eigenmultiplicities 48,50,50,50,50 on E8; PBW gives this all-order trace.

equations.title: finite Fourier grade populations
equations.assumptions: Use the 125-character Fourier inversion for G=F5^3; all nonidentity twines coincide. The same formula applies to universal PBW counts.

equations.title: graded relation deficit
equations.assumptions: The deficit counts the full null ideal at a degree and grade; it is not the arc-kernel dimension.

equations.title: neutral-sector imbalance
equations.assumptions: This is exact Fourier algebra and gives an all-order test of whether discarded states are grade-uniform.

equations.title: asymptotic retention
equations.assumptions: Character asymptotics describe n tending to infinity for the fixed level-one simple quotient and universal PBW population.

equations.title: split Casimir from exact metric
equations.assumptions: G is the normalized invariant metric with roots of squared length two; large fourth-order arrays are unnecessary.

equations.title: five adjoint tensor channels
equations.assumptions: Multiplicity-free E8 representation decomposition; four adjoint invariant tensors therefore form a five-dimensional space.

equations.title: spectral projectors
equations.assumptions: The five actual split-Casimir eigenvalues are -60,-30,-12,0,2; denominator primes lie among 2,3,5,7,31.

equations.title: KZ pair residues
equations.assumptions: The implementation reconstructs matrices from invariant-tensor evaluations and checks additional evaluations independently.

equations.title: five-channel KZ system
equations.assumptions: Generic complex level k!=-30. All five classical tensor channels survive the integrable fusion interpretation when k>=4.

equations.title: five invariant tensor frame
equations.assumptions: A certified invertible evaluation minor fixes the frame. Tensor identities must be checked beyond the interpolation points.

equations.title: crossing involution
equations.equation: C^2=I; B=C A C^-1 for the declared pair permutation
equations.assumptions: The exact permutation convention accompanies the matrices; crossing does not by itself prove every desired quantum identity.

equations.title: residue characteristic identity
equations.assumptions: The factors encode eigenvalues 0,-60,-30,-12,2 in root-length-squared-two normalization.

equations.title: Frobenius recurrence
equations.assumptions: F=z^rho sum_n v_n z^n near zero. Singular recurrence matrices require compatibility or logarithmic terms.

equations.title: resonance condition
equations.equation: rho_j-rho_i in positive integers with rho_i=lambda_i/(k+30)
equations.assumptions: Resonance is a candidate for logarithms, not a proof that logarithms occur; compatibility must be evaluated on the actual residues.

equations.title: resonance compatibility witness
equations.equation: ell^T M=0 and ell^T rhs!=0 => M v=rhs has no solution
equations.assumptions: An exact left-kernel row certifies failure of a log-free Frobenius recurrence at the specified order and level.

equations.title: logarithmic Frobenius ansatz
equations.equation: F=z^rho sum_n sum_j v_(n,j) z^n (log z)^j
equations.assumptions: Generalized recurrence coefficients must be solved when resonance blocks an ordinary series; unresolved log orders remain explicit.

equations.title: certified noncommuting holonomy pair
equations.assumptions: Gaussian-rational Taylor transport, rational Cauchy bounds and reflected-path crossing enclose both generator holonomies. This certifies a nonabelian image, not a classification or density theorem for the full monodromy group.

equations.title: terminating hypergeometric sum
equations.assumptions: Use rising factorials, nonnegative integer N, and no zero denominator on the sum's support.

equations.title: Racah factorial sum
equations.equation: {a b p;c d q}=Delta(a,b,p)Delta(a,d,q)Delta(c,b,q)Delta(c,d,p) sum_z (-1)^z(z+1)!/(four lower factorials times three upper factorials)
equations.assumptions: Admissible triangle data fix all factorial arguments and summation bounds; rational normalization can avoid unnecessary radicals.

equations.title: principal recoupling
equations.assumptions: Clebsch-Gordan normalization and phase conventions must be fixed before comparing the polynomial implementation.

equations.title: recoupling orthogonality
equations.assumptions: Use normalized coordinates or the declared rational-frame Gram matrix; a nonorthonormal polynomial frame uses a weighted identity.

equations.title: associativity pentagon
equations.assumptions: The symbol denotes compatible recouplings of four representations; pentagon consistency alone does not impose E8 Jacobi on arbitrary reduced constants.

equations.title: reduced Jacobi constraints
equations.assumptions: Compile all components of Hom_sl2(V_a tensor V_b tensor V_c,V_d), including intermediate spins outside the eight E8 exponents.

equations.title: forbidden-channel cancellation
equations.equation: Jacobi_component_q=0 also for q notin M
equations.assumptions: Only the first bracket's actual output is restricted to M; recoupling intermediate spaces can contain additional spins.

equations.title: differential current Lie algebra
equations.assumptions: The bracket is wedge times Lie bracket with graded signs. Positive current order makes the coefficient ideal nilpotent.

equations.title: homotopy transfer contract
equations.assumptions: Actual cochain maps and a homotopy are required before transferring a DGLA to an L-infinity algebra.

equations.title: finite higher brackets by current order
equations.equation: ell_n=0 for n>N on positive-order currents modulo t^(N+1)
equations.assumptions: Every n-input transferred tree has current order at least n; the chosen homotopy acts on the geometric factor only.

equations.title: Moyal enveloping closure
equations.equation: [x tensor f,y tensor g]_star=([x,y] tensor (f star g+g star f)+(xy+yx) tensor (f star g-g star f))/2
equations.assumptions: The identity holds in U(g) tensor A_star. Symmetric products force directions beyond bare g when scalar multiplication is noncommutative.

equations.title: E8 symmetric closure obstruction
equations.assumptions: There is no E8-equivariant symmetric multiplication into the adjoint that closes the generic Moyal correction inside 248 directions.

equations.title: principal quantum embedding obstruction
equations.equation: delta(sum_i e_i)=sum_i h_i wedge e_i notin wedge^2(sl2_principal)
equations.assumptions: For the standard Drinfeld-Jimbo cobracket, the principal embedding is not a Lie-bialgebra embedding. This does not exclude every twisted or quasi-Hopf alternative.

equations.title: compatible twist search
equations.equation: delta^f(s) subset wedge^2(s); delta^f(x)=delta(x)+[x tensor1+1tensor x,f]
equations.assumptions: The classical twist equation and higher quantization obligations must also hold; solving the linear inclusion alone is insufficient.

equations.title: elliptic E8 dynamical dependence
equations.equation: R=R(z,lambda), lambda in h^*, dim h=8
equations.assumptions: Use an established dynamical or half-current elliptic framework. An ordinary theta rescaling of the existing finite brackets does not prove Yang-Baxter consistency.

equations.title: affine PBW straightening
equations.assumptions: Negative modes acting on the vacuum; a declared total order and exact commutators produce PBW normal forms.

equations.title: vacuum annihilation
equations.assumptions: A positive-mode action can introduce central terms while commuting through negative modes.

equations.title: level-one singular vector
equations.assumptions: The vector is nonzero in the universal level-one vacuum module and generates the standard integrability null submodule.

equations.title: null descendant propagation
equations.assumptions: Exact PBW replay certifies each displayed descendant; a null descendant is not automatically a new arc-kernel generator.

equations.title: Li leading symbol
equations.equation: sigma_Li(v)=leading filtration component of the exact PBW relation
equations.assumptions: Conformal degree, PBW length and Li degree are distinct gradings and must be recorded separately.

equations.title: arc-to-Li map
equations.assumptions: This canonical map can have nonzero kernel even when the vertex algebra has a simple character formula.

equations.title: arc relation defect
equations.assumptions: The arc-kernel differs from the entire affine null ideal. Computing characters alone does not identify these missing relations.

equations.title: complete weight-four arc kernel
equations.assumptions: Projected polarization proves the cubic ideal and mixed-jet quotient dimensions; the explicit3875 null-symbol submodule therefore exhausts the weight-four kernel. The infinite differential kernel remains unclassified.

equations.title: exact nonmembership functional
equations.equation: ell^T M=0; ell^T v!=0 => v notin image M
equations.assumptions: A fully enumerated sector's relation matrix M and exact functional certify that a new relation is not generated by the declared old relations.

equations.title: complete kernel presentation gate
equations.equation: ker pi=<explicit generators and their differential consequences>
equations.assumptions: Requires inclusion in both directions and a completeness argument; finitely many computed degrees alone do not close the global gate.

equations.title: projected polarization spectrum
equations.assumptions: Four explicit highest vectors exhaust Sym^3(g). The complementary scalars39/31,18/7,8/7,0 identify the projected-gradient kernel and prove the complete weight-four arc dimension.

equations.title: relation entropy
equations.assumptions: This logarithmic retention measure is a declared interpretation of exact graded counts; it does not assign physical entropy without further assumptions.

equations.title: index-five lattice gluing
equations.assumptions: The union consists of five cosets of A4+A4; weight one realizes 48+4*50=248.

equations.title: hypergeometric modular period
equations.assumptions: Choose the branch near the modular cusp and compatible theta conventions. The hypergeometric period cancels in the unrefined normalized character E4/eta^8.

equations.title: explicit quadratic highest vector
equations.equation: e_i Q=0 for i=1..8; wt(Q)=omega_3875; Q in Sym^2(g)
equations.assumptions: The primitive seven-term quadratic is constructed by exact raising-map nullspace; its finite irreducible module has dimension 3875.

equations.title: equivariant cubic jet generator
equations.assumptions: Use the actual invariant dual basis. The displayed highest vector has 783 nonzero terms and Li degree one at conformal weight four.

equations.title: reduced affine Gram certificate
equations.assumptions: The frame is Sym(F_Q), Q_(3,1), Q_(2,2). Full-sector pairing, not only this reduced matrix, certifies the null relation.

equations.title: explicit weight-four null lift
equations.assumptions: The actual PBW lift has 804 terms. Its leading Li symbol is F_Q and it vanishes in the level-one simple quotient.

equations.title: complete root-weight radical check
equations.equation: <w,R>=0 for all 14441 PBW monomials of conformal weight4 and root weight omega_3875
equations.assumptions: The exhaustive flag regenerates the complete sector; other root weights pair to zero by Cartan invariance. Counts are not a full infinite-kernel presentation.

equations.title: old-source highest-weight exclusion
equations.equation: ker(raise on Sym^3(g)_omega)=0; ker(raise and Omega12-2 on (Sym^2(g) tensor g)_omega)=0
equations.assumptions: Full-column-rank modular certificates at prime1009 prove rational injectivity and exclude a 3875 component from the old differential relation sources.

equations.title: recoupling constraint loss certificate
equations.assumptions: All 15 intermediate equation coordinates are retained. Keeping only exponent-labelled coordinates loses nine independent quadratic constraints in this specific problem.

equations.title: first graded relation imbalance
equations.assumptions: Together with finite Fourier inversion, null removal is uniform across all125 grades through degree4 and first differs by48 between neutral and each nonneutral grade at degree5.

equations.title: equivariant two-cochain dimension
equations.assumptions: The multiplicity-free principal decomposition and Clebsch-Gordan rules give these finite dimensions; all eight spins occur once.

equations.title: actual diagonal gauge derivative
equations.assumptions: Columns are the derivatives of diagonal basis scalings in the actual principal coordinates; the exact matrix has rank eight.

equations.title: principal-action fixed gauge
equations.equation: s_1=0 => dim im G_fixed=7 in a 162-dimensional coefficient slice
equations.assumptions: All eight principal action coefficients are fixed. On gauge tangents their variation depends on the single parameter s_1.

equations.title: Whitehead equivariant exactness
equations.assumptions: Uses Whitehead's lemma and exactness of taking invariants for finite-dimensional semisimple sl2 modules. The principal centralizer is zero.

equations.title: reduced tangent rank
equations.assumptions: 155 literal independent selected Jacobian rows and seven actual gauge columns give matching bounds. The complete grid is not assembled; Whitehead supplies an independent theoretical cross-check.

equations.title: reconstructed gauge tangent
equations.equation: s=G_pivot^-1 v_pivot; v is tangent iff v=G s
equations.assumptions: The supplied invertible gauge minor gives an exact membership test and a failing row functional; completeness uses the declared Whitehead dependency.

equations.title: Cartan conformal null relations
equations.assumptions: The31Jordan Cartans have disjoint quadratic supports, giving30independent neutral null relations; they do not exhaust the216neutral quadratic null states.

equations.title: Cartan average and Sugawara
equations.assumptions: The universal Sugawara expression is the average; equality of individual rank-eight Cartan states holds in the simple level-one quotient. No unrestricted mod31 equivalence is asserted.
